insight: Acquired by cybersecurity giant Check Point in 2025; its models train on attacks from its viral Gandalf game.
name: Lakera
tagline: Real-time guardrails against prompt injection and jailbreaks for AI apps.
description: Lakera Guard sits between users and LLMs as a low-latency security layer, detecting and blocking direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, and system-prompt extraction across 100+ languages. Its models are trained on adversarial data from Gandalf, Lakera's prompt-injection game. Acquired by Check Point in 2025.

modelSupport.notes: Guards any LLM-backed app via an API in front of the model.

changelog.summary: Corrected acquirer — Lakera was acquired by Check Point in 2025, not Cisco (that was Robust Intelligence).

edge: Detection models trained on 80M+ real adversarial prompts from its viral Gandalf game; sub-50ms inline latency.
pros: Detection sharpened by the Gandalf game
Covers injection, jailbreaks, PII, data loss
Model-agnostic API in front of any LLM
